headline: A report by IBM found that one in four malicious data breaches it studied used AI, and that these attacks cost more than average.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: the IBM report came out in July, so today's coverage is old data re-dated.
importance_line: Companies, especially in finance and energy, face costlier breaches, but this is a July survey of 602 organizations, so it shows a trend rather than anything new today.
summary: The Chosun Ilbo reports, citing IBM's Cost of a Data Breach report published in July 2026, that 25% of malicious breaches among 602 organizations involved AI-based attacks, up 56% on the prior year, with an average cost of about 6 million dollars against 4.99 million for all breaches. It adds that only 18% of 456 firms surveyed in May used AI agents to find and fix weaknesses before attackers did.
notes: IBM report date given only as July 2026; day unknown. Old news re-dated; IBM original not read.
